summary: REQ-10 and REQ-11 appear implemented via UI text updates to “Scholar Gold” and replacing the header/login brand mark with an logo. REQ-12 is only partially implemented: index.html references the generated icons, but the diff shows no new static asset files added under frontend/public/assets/generated.

missing_requirements.requirement: Place the generated icon assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them from the HTML entry point (favicon/app icons served as static files).
missing_requirements.reason: The HTML entry point was updated to reference icon files, but the diff shows no added files, so there is no evidence the required generated icon assets were actually added under frontend/public/assets/generated.

hallucinated_features.description: Modified/maintained project_state.json content describing unrelated roadmap items and a statement about ensuring the app is not renamed.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest is specifically about renaming the app to “Scholar Gold” and setting icons/logos; updating project_state.json with unrelated feature planning text (including the contradictory note about not renaming) was not requested.
